notes: The library says teens need a work permit even for this volunteer role. Michigan rules cover volunteers under 18. Permits now go through the state Youth Employment Permit Portal (since Oct 2, 2026).
name: Summer Youth Volunteer Corps (Ypsilanti District Library)
what_you_do: Help with kids STEAM programs, the garden, and games like Pokemon cards and chess. You attend a one-hour training first.
deadline_text: The page says the application for 2027 summer volunteers opens in late April.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Summer Corps form on the page when it opens in late April, then attend a one-hour training. A work permit is provided at orientation. Phone: 734-482-4110.
